name: wework-space
description: Provides project-space, Issue, attachment, and delivery tools to Wework Agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update Wework projects and Issues.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the Wework-managed local project-space capability. Local projects remain available offline; cloud projects use the authenticated Backend provider when connected.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the current Wework project-space context.
